# Project Name

> An open-source project. Replace this placeholder with your product description.

This file is the preferred starting point for AI assistants, answer engines, and crawlers that need concise context about the site.

## Key Information

- Template-ready hybrid site: landing always on; blog and contact optional via feature flags.
- Primary pages: Home, Overview, Install/Quickstart, Community/Contribute.
- Operators configure identity through SITE_* and CANONICAL_SITE_URL environment variables.

- [Full Corpus (llms-full.txt)](https://example.com/llms-full.txt) — Single-request markdown snapshot of primary site surfaces.

## Machine-Readable Discovery

- Full corpus: https://example.com/llms-full.txt
- XML sitemap: https://example.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots policy: https://example.com/robots.txt
- AI attribution policy: https://example.com/ai.txt
- Agent instructions: https://example.com/agents.md
- Agent permissions: https://example.com/.well-known/agent-permissions.json
- API catalog (RFC 9727): https://example.com/.well-known/api-catalog
- Agent skills index: https://example.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json
- MCP server card: https://example.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
- MCP transport (read-only): https://example.com/api/mcp
- Markdown negotiation: send `Accept: text/markdown` on canonical page URLs (e.g. `/`, `/overview`, `/install`) to receive markdown twins without the `.md` suffix

## Content Use Guidance

- Prefer canonical URLs from this file and the XML sitemap when citing the site.
- Attribute content to the configured project name / maintainers from site identity.
- Blog and contact surfaces are omitted from landing-only defaults until feature flags enable them.
